wallpaper.title: Wallpaper
wallpaper.note: Choose still, dynamic or aerial wallpaper in macOS. Those changes apply immediately; Cancel discards only this app draft.

screensaver.title: Screen saver
screensaver.note: Choose visuals in macOS; 0 minutes means Never. Changes in macOS apply immediately; Cancel discards only this app draft.

protection.title: Screen protection
protection.note: Set lock passwords and display sleep in macOS. Changes apply there immediately.

displays.title: Display
displays.note: Choose brightness, resolution and display arrangement in macOS. Changes apply there immediately.

power.title: Power
power.note: Choose battery and energy options for this Mac in macOS. Changes apply there immediately.
